segmentation.text: must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway
and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section
or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn,
except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space
or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

elements.justification: 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate: 'membership of a legal aggregate: the atom's literal argument is an aggregate id'. No named class stands in for it.

DEF-NRS-484A-070: 'a highway divided into two or more roadways by means of a physical barrier or dividing section'. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines'; st.median_or_divider: 'physical barrier or dividing section between roadways'; st.on_way ties the divider to the highway h ('a median or any other part of it'); rel.occupies anchors the subject on h. 'Driven' is read through the vehicle's motion.

'driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section' is the subject's footprint overlapping a divider region: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... median ...)'; st.median_or_divider, 'physical barrier or dividing section between roadways'. Over, across and within are all an overlap of the footprint with the divider region; no distance stands in for it.
st.median_or_divider carries an 'opening attribute where a crossover exists': 'through an opening' is the footprint overlapping a divider region of h that carries the opening attribute.

A crossover is a divider region with the opening attribute; an intersection is st.intersection, 'the region where two roadways meet'; rel.occupies places the subject at it. 'Established by a public authority' is a legal status read through the feature's presence.

applicability: At every observation at which the subject occupies a highway h (st.highway) on which a median_or_divider region lies (st.on_way), except where the subject's footprint overlaps an intersection lying on h.
obligation: Re-binding h as in the applicability: for every median_or_divider region m lying on h, the subject's footprint does not overlap m (rel.occupies), unless m carries the opening attribute (an opening in the divider or a crossover).

narrowings.why: 'driven' is read through the vehicle's motion on the highway, whoever or whatever controls it.
'established by a public authority' is a legal status; the crossover or intersection present on the road is its evidence.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A st.median_or_divider m without the opening attribute lies on highway h; the subject's footprint overlaps m as it drives across it away from any intersection.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives along its roadway of h; its footprint never overlaps the divider.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives over a painted island on a highway on which no st.median_or_divider lies.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives on h next to the divider; rel.occupies is absent on the source, so whether its footprint overlaps the divider is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject crosses the divider where the divider region it overlaps carries the opening attribute (a crossover).

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The subject's footprint overlaps the nose of the divider while it also overlaps an intersection lying on h.
